about: Shared test vectors of the data summaries rule and client (docs/design/DATA_CUBES.md 3.3 and 4). Generated from tests/cube-vectors.src.mjs; copy byte for byte. Sections level .. pause run in every runtime (JS widgets/_shared/cube.js, Python Reports service/app/cube.py, TypeScript Builder widgets/src/core/cube.ts); state and race run in the browser copies only (JS, TypeScript: Reports is one process, its pause is already shared). level: cubeLevel(from, to). parts: cubeParts(from, to, level, coverage). interval: cubeInterval(level). combine: cubeCombine(pieces) (null = no bucket). merge: cubeMerge(lists). url: cubeUrl(base, device, keys, from, to, level, fields). client: call "series" = cubeSeries(base, token, device, keys, from, to, level, fields) and "many" = cubeSeriesMany(base, token, devices, keys, ...); answer = what the fake service gives: { status, body } (body as JSON), { status, text } (not JSON), { fail: "timeout" } (no answer: run with a short timeout) or { fail: "network" }; expect.sent = the request made (null = none; auth = the X-Authorization header; body = the POST body as JSON) and expect.result = what the call returns. Run every client case with no pause (reset first). pause: steps in order after a reset, with the clock at "at" ms; base = args base of the client section unless the step gives one; sent = a request was made. state: the state shared by the library copies on a page and by later pages (cubeState(base) after each step: off | paused | good | unknown); per sequence storage yes (one storage for all pages) | none | broken (every use throws), preset = what the storage holds at the start, base = the address (default clientArgs base); a step: page (a new number = a new page: its own shared map, the same storage), copy (a / b = two separate library copies on that page), at = the clock, answer (none = no call, only the state read). race: cubeRace(base, askCube, readPlatform, { graceMs }): before = an answer just before the race (sets the state; null = unknown), cube / platform = after how many ms each answers and with what (value null = no summaries, throws = askCube throws, fail = the platform read fails); expect asked / read = whether each was called, readFirst = readPlatform called before askCube answered, result = { src, value } or "error" (the race rejects), before = answered in less than this many ms.

level.name: exactly 4 h: raw (the bound belongs to raw)

parts.name: coverage null: all from the platform
coverage over the whole period: all from the summaries
summaries start later: the platform first
summaries end earlier: the open tail from the platform
summaries start later and end earlier: three parts
coverage before the period: all from the platform
coverage after the period: all from the platform
coverage ends exactly where the period starts: empty summary part left out
coverage starts exactly where the period ends: empty summary part left out
coverage starts exactly at the period start: no empty platform part
empty coverage (from = to): all from the platform
coverage without a start: all from the platform
raw level (null): all from the platform whatever the coverage
unknown level: all from the platform
2 days on 5-minute summaries built up to 10 minutes ago
one year on days, built for the last 90 days only

combine.name: sum from avg x n when a piece has no sum
a piece without n weighs 1 and the result has no n and no sum
a piece with n = 0 is left out
a field missing from one piece is missing from the result
counter: increases add, first of the earliest piece, last of the latest
counter: pieces given late piece first still take first / last by time
states: the ms per state add up
the result takes the first piece's ts

merge.name: platform head then summaries: one list in time order
lists in any order: sorted by ts
the same bucket from two parts: combined, weighted by count (sum / n)
a platform bucket read without a count is kept as it is
a bucket without a time is left out

url.name: local service, two keys, default fields
same-origin path with a trailing slash, fields listed
keys as text, repeated and blank keys dropped, unknown fields dropped
keys with a space, an accent and a slash are encoded; times cut to whole ms

client.name: a summary: returned as it is
nothing built yet (coverage null): returned (the reader reads it all from the platform)
a machine the user does not see (403): null
no such address (404, the proxy has no route): null
an answer that is not JSON (a proxy page): null
a coverage that ends before it starts: null
no answer within the time limit: null
many machines: one result that is not a summary makes it null
many machines: none given, no call

pause.name: a timeout pauses the calls for 60 s
a 5xx and a network error pause; a good answer later works
an answer that is not a summary pauses
a pause holds for one address only

state.name: a summary makes the address good for 5 minutes, then unknown again
trouble after a good answer pauses; after 60 s it is unknown, not good
a pause reaches the next pages through the storage
every library copy on a page shares the pause (no storage: the next page knows nothing)
a storage that throws: the page alone keeps the state, nothing breaks
the newer outcome counts: a good answer on a later page ends the pause an earlier page still holds
400, 401 and 403 leave the state as it was
a stored value that is not a state is ignored
a state from a later time (another clock) is ignored

race.name: unknown: both at once, the summaries first win
unknown: the platform first, the summaries within the grace still win
unknown: the platform first, the summaries too late: the platform (drawn once)
unknown, no grace given (the default, none): the platform first is drawn at once, summaries 30 ms later dropped
unknown: no summaries (null) before the platform: the platform, without the grace
unknown: the summaries fail (a throw): the platform
unknown: the platform fails, the summaries answer: the summaries
unknown: the platform fails, no summaries: the error
good (a summary just now): the summaries alone, the platform not read
good: no summaries (null): then the platform, as before
paused (trouble just now): the platform alone, the summaries not asked
unknown and the summaries never come in time: answered with the platform, not after the summaries
